name: coachdesk
description: Coachdesk: client management for personal trainers. NestJS + MongoDB + React

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w apps/server && npm test -w apps/web
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed -w apps/server
